notes.title: 📢 Steam Patch Notes - February 11, 2025
notes.content:
This update brings new anomalies and various fixes to improve stability.

🔹 Update Details
✅ 6 New Anomalies Added

Mysterious anomalies have emerged, each with unique properties that may alter the environment.
✅ Fixed Invisible Button UI Issue

Certain button UI elements that were not displaying correctly are now visible again.
✅ Improved Stability of Some Anomalies

Some anomalies that behaved unpredictably have been adjusted.
✅ Gallery Space Now Accessible

The gallery space has been opened and is now accessible.
For the administrators of Separium, we will continue to create a better environment.

AI-Purry
